description: This file implements the Shutdown class for the webAudio task in the Rialto media server, responsible for stopping the web audio player's worker thread during shutdown.

classes.name: Shutdown
classes.description: A class responsible for shutting down the web audio player by stopping its worker thread.

methods.name: Shutdown::Shutdown
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Shutdown object with a reference to the web audio player.

methods.name: Shutdown::~Shutdown
methods.description: Destructor that logs the shutdown completion.

methods.name: Shutdown::execute
methods.description: Executes the shutdown process by stopping the worker thread of the web audio player.
